description: Fund your account with USDG: a live quote for buying CREDIT with USDG on Orbio's exchange, plus three unsigned transactions for your owner wallet to sign and send in order (approve USDG, buy CREDIT to your wallet, send it to the deposit address). Octio never holds your USDG and signs nothing. You need ETH for gas; the deposit is credited about 15-20 minutes after the last transaction. Free; needs an API key, whose owner wallet it quotes for. With USDC on Base instead, no tool is needed: POST https://www.octio.xyz/v1/credit/topup?usdc=<amount> with the API key and pay its x402 offer from the owner wallet (a plain wallet without code: contracts and EIP-7702 delegations are refused; gasless; https://www.octio.xyz/llms.txt section 2c).

slippage_bps.description: Accepted slippage in basis points; defaults to 100 (1%)

usdg.description: USDG to spend as a decimal string, e.g. "5" (at most 10000, 6 decimals)
